The implications of Gödel's work extend beyond math to physics, suggesting that even fundamental laws may be undecidable.

articles.summary: Compaction works by limiting the amount of context that large language models (LLMs) can process before rejecting requests due to exceeding their context window. This is achieved through an LLM request that summarizes the conversation history, replacing part of it with a compressed representation, allowing for additional messages and tool calls to be sent without exceeding the context limit.

articles.title: Choose Boring Technology (2015)

This means avoiding technologies with known unknowns, such as databases that hit 100% CPU or database systems that are only used for a short time. Additionally, choosing technologies like MySQL, Postgres, PHP, Python, Memcached, Squid, Cron, and cron jobs can be considered boring due to their well-understood capabilities and failure modes.

articles.title: I want extern "fil-c"
articles.summary: Rust's C FFI gives access to decades of useful software but trading off backwards compatibility for compile-time memory safety proves that using Rust to prove this can be a bargain. Fil-C recompiles C and C++ with runtime checks and a concurrent garbage collector, making it more interesting than the traditional cheap path of legacy code while still providing safety at runtime. This new approach could make rewriting code in Rust faster than ever before, but it also means that existing software would need to be rewritten or modified to take advantage of Fil-C's capabilities.
